Hey everyone!

We’re currently a team of 2 EECS undergrads + 1 Master’s student working on a project in mechanistic interpretability — exploring how mechanical decisions emerge and can be analyzed within robotic automation.

We’re excited to dive deeper into the intersection of Mechanistic Interpretability (proj. 3)

We’re looking for one more teammate who’s excited about interpretability, VPAs, or just understanding how AI “thinks.” 

If that sounds like you, message me — we’d love to have you join our team!
